tex_content.html:
Lemma
[the parallel-transport coefficient is a bounded linear operator]

↗ def:dc-ch2-2-5

1. ch2:2.6For a chart velocity $v$ and base point $y$, the map $w\mapsto \Gamma (v,w)(y)$ is a bounded linear operator $A(v,y)$ on the finite-dimensional model space. Thus $w\mapsto -\Gamma (\dot u(t),w)(u(t))$ is globally Lipschitz with constant $\lVert A(\dot u(t),u(t))\rVert $.
